outcome: intention for cesarean section versus normal vaginal delivery
cohort: 400 pregnant women aged 18-38 years, with gestational age of 24-40 weeks
finding: The role of the physician, subjective norms, and body image were significant determinants of intention for cesarean section.
mod_finding: This study found that intention for cesarean section was influenced by the role of the physician, subjective norms, and body image.
